title: Moving Goods
description: Everything we lift in Thornfield gets hauled back to Dalhurst to sell, and every mile of that is a mile a patrol can search you. Silas will take the trade locally if he believes you are real. One delivery.

objectives.description: Take the package from Raven, no questions about the contents
Get the package to Silas past the road patrols
Bring Silas's confirmation back to Raven

challenge.description: Avoid guard patrols on the road. Getting caught may result in confiscation or fine.

notes: Promotion to Footpad upon completion. Establishes fence contact in Thornfield. Silas becomes recurring NPC. Threat: getting searched costs 50 gold and standing with the Guild (data field 'challenge.detection_penalty', unwired to any mechanic this pass can touch). Giver motive: a local Thornfield fence saves the Guild the Dalhurst road every time they move goods. Consequence: unwired beyond the flat penalty already in the data - no world state records whether the fence connection is compromised.
